configuration:
repos:
  - repo: local
    hooks:
      - id: disrobe
        name: disrobe (block packed/obfuscated artifacts)
        description: Analyze staged files with `disrobe auto` and fail the commit when a packed or obfuscated artifact is detected. Requires the `disrobe` binary on PATH (or set DISROBE_BIN).
        entry: hooks/pre-commit-gate.sh
        language: script
        types: [file]
        require_serial: false
        minimum_pre_commit_version: "2.18.0"

steps.stderr:
warning: in the working copy of '.pre-commit-config.yaml', LF will be replaced by CRLF the next time Git touches it
warning: in the working copy of 'hooks/pre-commit-gate.sh', LF will be replaced by CRLF the next time Git touches it

steps.stdout:
disrobe (block packed/obfuscated artifacts)..............................Passed
- hook id: disrobe
- duration: 0.25s

disrobe (block packed/obfuscated artifacts)..............................Failed
- hook id: disrobe
- duration: 0.63s
- exit code: 1

disrobe-gate: BLOCKED hello.packed.exe: native.packer-unpack (packer-archive)
disrobe-gate: commit blocked - packed/protected artifact(s) detected.
disrobe-gate: inspect with 'disrobe auto <file> --json', or skip with SKIP=disrobe git commit.
